raw_segments.text: Bad work, bad work, Mr. Starbuck, said Stub, regarding the wreck.
But the sea will have its way.
Stub for one can't fight it.
You see, Mr. Starbuck, a wave has such a great long start before it leaps, all around the
world it runs and then comes the spring.
But as for me, all the start I have to meet it is just across the deck here.
So the old song says, Sings.
